scenarios.discriminates: subject domain as realm: sample shows workgroup\m0...

scenarios.discriminates: different decoding of the two shapes: 5, alert

scenarios.description: UNOBSERVED SHAPE: subject name present but SubjectUserSid S-1-0-0, TargetDomainName '-', five subject domains, one target name
scenarios.discriminates: specification: 1 account (?\bob); subject domain as realm: 5, alert
scenarios.known_limitation: Under the RC1 decoder steps this shape maps user.id to TargetUserSid (step 8) and keeps user.domain = SubjectDomainName, so user.id == user.target.id and the derivation takes the realm from user.domain: the subject's domain. Windows is not known to write a subject name with the NULL SID; the replay records what the RC2 decoders do.
